data.name: Jaiyana
data.gender_notes: Jaiyana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-y-n, meaning 'to flow gently' or 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, Jaiyana symbolizes grace, gentleness, and compassion. The name Jaiyana carries the meaning “Gentle, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaiyana usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in spiritual significance, Jaiyana represents the gentle, compassionate nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
data.etymology: Jaiyana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaiyana total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
